stem: Which one of the following pairs of angles is supplementary?
solution: Supplementary angles are two angles that add up to $180^\circ$ (together they make a straight angle).

Add the two angles in each pair: ${=p}^\circ + {=180 - p}^\circ = 180^\circ$; ${=q}^\circ + {=90 - q}^\circ = 90^\circ$; ${=d}^\circ + {=360 - d}^\circ = 360^\circ$; ${=e}^\circ + {=f}^\circ = {=e + f}^\circ$; ${=c}^\circ + {=c}^\circ = {=2 * c}^\circ$.
Only ${=p}^\circ$ and ${=180 - p}^\circ$ add up to $180^\circ$, so that is the supplementary pair. (A pair that adds up to $90^\circ$ is complementary.)

proposed_misconceptions.label: Swaps complementary and supplementary
proposed_misconceptions.description: The student checks for a sum of $90^\circ$ (complementary) when asked for supplementary angles, which add up to $180^\circ$.

proposed_misconceptions.label: Takes a sum of 360 degrees as supplementary
proposed_misconceptions.description: The student confuses the straight angle ($180^\circ$) with the full turn ($360^\circ$) and accepts a pair that adds up to $360^\circ$.

proposed_misconceptions.label: Takes two equal angles for a supplementary pair
proposed_misconceptions.description: The student mixes supplementary angles up with vertically opposite angles, which are equal, and picks a pair of equal angles.

notes: Covers the 'supplementary and complementary angles' part of the objective by the definition of the names (sum 180 and sum 90); the book's own questions for this objective only name angle types, so this is a recognition item at the same level, with no diagram and no transversal. The stem never changes (distinct_by_choices set; the options carry the variation). Exactly one option sums to 180 by construction: complementary pair sums to 90, the 360 pair to 360, the near-miss pair to 160, 170, 190 or 200 (180 + s, s in -20, -10, 10, 20), the equal pair to 60..140 (c in 30..70, c not 45, so it is never 90 or 180). p is never 90 so the correct pair is never an equal pair. The near-miss option is an arithmetic-slip distractor with no catalogued error, so its id is null. No two options can show the same pair: sums differ.
